mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days by reducing discount rates applied to equity cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite FEDFUNDS declining, or the decline is not sustained (rank IC < 0.05 over 3mo).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5 percentage points triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, reflecting weakening labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive in > 70% of triggered instances despite UNRATE crossing above 4.5%, or the rate increase is not sustained (3mo rolling average).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous surge in GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, amplifying demand-driven equity valuation expansion.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative despite both GDPC1 and HOUST rising significantly, or their combined effect is weak (rank IC < 0.15 over 6mo).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained increase in the federal funds rate predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as higher interest rates compress equity discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive in > 50% of instances during tightening cycles despite rising FEDFUNDS, or the tightening is not sustained (3mo average).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the industrial production index below 110 predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, signaling supply-side shocks that disrupt production and demand.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive when INDPRO drops below 110, or the drop is not significant (rank IC < 0.1 over 1mo).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5 percentage points predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, reflecting stronger labor market conditions and consumer confidence.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative despite UNRATE falling below 4.5%, or the decline is not sustained (3mo average).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDP growth (GDPC1) and final sales (RSAFS) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, strengthening demand for equities through dual economic indicators.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative despite both GDPC1 and RSAFS rising significantly, or their combined effect is weak (rank IC < 0.2 over 6mo).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a surge in housing starts (HOUST) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, signaling peak demand and speculative buying.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative during late-cycle expansion despite rising HOUST, or the surge is not sustained (3mo average).
